sources.name: Diário do Rio
sources.known_constraint: Current sitemap returned HTTP 200 on 2026-09-09 with 1,000 entries, all lacking publication_date; URL paths covered August 25–September 9. For windows up to seven days, undated sitemap entries are deferred with an explicit coverage gap so current archive fetches do not swamp historical canaries. Wider jobs retain the supplemental body scan. Domain Google history always runs; historical completeness remains unverified. The former WordPress API returned HTTP 403 and is no longer scheduled. lastmod is never treated as publication date.

evidence.basis: existing WordPress collector configuration
Direct public HTTP 200 with an XML urlset, 315,075 bytes; not advertised by robots.txt.
Canary readiness recheck: HTTP 200, 315,061 bytes, 1,000 URL entries with loc/lastmod and zero publication_date fields; captured /tmp/diario-canary-sitemap-live.xml.

sources.name: Câmara Municipal do Rio
sources.known_constraint: On 2026-09-09 the archive was locally reachable and dated pages descended from September 8 into August, but Render connections to both apex and www timed out before TLS. No working alternate route was found. Consecutive fully parsed descending pages allow stopping after all dates pass below the requested start; unknown or inconsistent ordering remains an explicit gap. A 50-page safety cap also remains visible. Historical Google queries run on terminal direct gaps.

evidence.basis: existing Câmara archive adapter
Live public HTTP 200 on 2026-09-09: 10 dated rows, August 26–18; page 1 September 8–August 28. Saved previous oldest date is checked across consecutive pages.
Publisher archive advertises /comunicacao/todas-noticias as canonical. Render apex/www both resolved 177.47.113.151 and timed out after 8seconds before TLS; no alternate configured.

sources.name: O Dia

sources.name: Super Rádio Tupi
sources.known_constraint: The publisher advertises its WordPress REST API. Default collection scans publication dates through that API; a live August 9 request reported 175 posts in two pages. Explicit API gaps queue domain Google fallback. Annual sitemap streaming remains available for supplemental backfill, with persistent snapshot cursors, but is not automatically scheduled because its entries lack publication dates. Nonarticle sitemap branches and old post years are skipped.

evidence.basis: publisher-advertised sitemap locations

Advertised annual sitemap timed out at15seconds; bounded45second retry returnedHTTP200 after33seconds but exceeded20MiB. Current transport limit prevents traversal; retained as a visible gap with domain Google fallback.

Repaired transport verified real HTTP 200: 113,595,181 bytes, 42,502 URL entries, 35.419 seconds for the initial index; subsequent 500-entry cursor batches took 0.016 and 0.015 seconds with no further HTTP. No articles saved.
Live HTTP 200 homepage Link header and HTML advertise https://www.tupi.fm/wp-json/ with rel=https://api.w.org/.
Live HTTP 200,175 posts,two pages; first100 records all have August 9 publication dates and explicit UTC date_gmt. No articles saved.
